data.title: SIM Swap Network-Level API Detection — Pre-MFA SIM Change Verification
data.description: Detects potential SIM swap attacks by querying network-level APIs before MFA code delivery. SIM swap fraud surged 1,055% in the UK (3,000 cases in 2024). Three network-level APIs provide the most effective detection: SIM Swap Check (has the SIM been changed recently?), Number Verification (is the number still assigned to the expected device?), and Call Forwarding Signal (is call forwarding active?). Correlating positive signals from these APIs with subsequent MFA authentication attempts provides high-confidence SIM swap detection.

detection.condition: sim_swap_check.recently_swapped == true OR number_verification.device_mismatch == true OR call_forwarding_signal.forwarding_active == true

queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for SIM Swap Network-Level API Detection")`
`comment("Correlates SIM change signals with MFA authentication attempts")`
index=flame_telecom sourcetype=flame:number_intelligence
| eval sim_risk = case(
    sim_swap_recently == "true", "HIGH",
    device_mismatch == "true", "HIGH",
    call_forwarding_active == "true", "MEDIUM",
    1=1, "LOW"
  )
| where sim_risk IN ("HIGH", "MEDIUM")
| join type=inner max=0 phone_number [
  search index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:mfa_events
  | where mfa_channel = "SMS"
  | where _time > relative_time(now(), "-1h")
]
| table _time, phone_number, customer_id, sim_risk,
        sim_swap_recently, sim_swap_timestamp,
        device_mismatch, call_forwarding_active,
        mfa_result
queries.sql:
-- SQL: Correlate SIM swap signals with MFA authentication
SELECT
    n.phone_number,
    n.check_timestamp,
    n.sim_swap_recently,
    n.sim_swap_date,
    n.device_mismatch,
    n.call_forwarding_active,
    m.mfa_event_time,
    m.mfa_result,
    m.customer_id,
    CASE
        WHEN n.sim_swap_recently = TRUE THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN n.device_mismatch = TRUE THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN n.call_forwarding_active = TRUE THEN 'MEDIUM'
    END AS risk_level
FROM number_intelligence_checks n
JOIN mfa_events m ON n.phone_number = m.phone_number
WHERE m.mfa_channel = 'SMS'
  AND m.mfa_event_time BETWEEN n.check_timestamp
      AND DATEADD(hour, 1, n.check_timestamp)
  AND (n.sim_swap_recently = TRUE
       OR n.device_mismatch = TRUE
       OR n.call_forwarding_active = TRUE)
ORDER BY n.check_timestamp DESC

references: Organized fraud detection in 2026: a technical landscape report — SIM swap detection
falsepositives: Users activating call forwarding for legitimate reasons
